invariants.rationale: Since the method constructs a new HoodieWriteMetadata object and returns it, the result should not be null.
The method is expected to perform an insert for a given instantTime, which should not be null.
The list of records to insert should not be null when passed to the insert method.
The engine context is required for performing insert actions, thus should not be null.
HoodieWriteMetadata should always contain a (possibly empty) list of WriteStatus objects after insertion.
